changes.challenger: Kurt Alme (R) vs. Alani Bankhead (D) vs. Seth Bodnar (I)
changes.notes: Daines did not seek re-election - he withdrew from the GOP primary at the June filing deadline and endorsed U.S. Attorney Kurt Alme; the seat is now open. Alani Bankhead won the Jun 2 Democratic primary over Reilly Neill (~12k-vote margin); ex-University of Montana president Seth Bodnar is running as an independent. Rating stays Solid R: Alme polls ~40% but the anti-R vote splits between Bodnar and Bankhead (Sabato Safe R; Inside Elections Solid R). As the Aug 10 withdrawal deadline passed, both Bankhead and Bodnar refused to exit despite pressure from 22 Democratic legislators and former Sens. Tester and Baucus.

CORRECTED CHALLENGER: Michele Tafoya (former NBC Sports sideline reporter) won the Aug 11 GOP primary over Adam Schwarze and Royce White; the earlier listing of state-party endorsee Adam Schwarze is superseded. On the DFL side, Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan won the nomination ~59-40 over Rep. Angie Craig. Open seat (Smith retiring); rating stays Likely D, with early general-election polls showing Flanagan +6-7.
